card.name: Unix command output after shell commands
card.fires_on: Pieces of terminal output that follow a Unix shell command, such as ls listings, permission strings, and service status lines. It also fires on the first piece of the output.

modes.label: Permission strings
modes.description: Parts of an ls -l permission string such as -rw or brw-r.

modes.label: Command result text
modes.description: The start of text a command prints back, such as a restart message or a man-page entry.
modes.example: /etc/rc.d/init.d/httpd restart Sh<<utting>> down http: [ OK ] Starting http
